source: synthetic. working.txt with its braille title frame replaced by U+25D0,
        the half-circle busy spinner Claude Code 2.1.228 switched to. Not a live
        capture: the harvested Claude on this machine is 2.1.220, which still
        animates braille. Everything below the header is working.txt verbatim.
why: this is the drift the parity plan opened with. Sidecar's hand-written
     claudeTitleWorking matched only U+2800-U+28FF, so on a current Claude the
     title rule fell through and idle detection had to carry the turn. Herdr's
     osc_title_working covers both ranges, and this fixture is what proves
     Sidecar inherited that without anyone writing a regex.

pane_current_command: 2.1.220
